comparison.objective: Carry a wide carrier through two offset overhead slots and set it level; candidate commissions a compact damper.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-1422 tests sustained bimanual grasping, coordinated 6-DoF transport, and obstacle negotiation; candidate tests localized tool alignment, rotary adjustment, and locking.
comparison.success_condition: PR-1422 requires passage and level placement, but the body omits numeric clearance/level thresholds and no spec versions exist. Candidate requires two safe impact responses and retention.
comparison.reason: Constrained wide-object transport is a different tested ability.
